mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reader_config (user_id, theme, font_size, line_height, page_margin, page_mode, sync_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{theme}, #{fontSize}, #{lineHeight}, #{pageMargin}, #{pageMode}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE reader_config SET theme = #{theme}, font_size = #{fontSize}, line_height = #{lineHeight}, page_margin = #{pageMargin}, page_mode = #{pageMode}, sync_version = sync_version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE reader_config SET theme = #{config.theme}, font_size = #{config.fontSize}, line_height = #{config.lineHeight}, page_margin = #{config.pageMargin}, page_mode = #{config.pageMode}, sync_version = sync_version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{config.id} AND sync_version = #{expectedVersion}
